text:
Hi there,

I'm Daniel Ross from Crestview Logistics Group. Your profile was shared with us and we'd like to offer you a remote Administrative Assistant internship at $32/hour. No experience is required.

Before you start, we will send you a check for $3,200. Deposit the check and use the funds to buy your laptop and software from our approved vendor.

Please confirm today.

Daniel Ross
Hiring Manager
crestview.logistics.hiring@outlook.com
